GSAP

The battle-tested animation engine, built for professionals.

Precise timelines, full control over easing, and a plugin ecosystem — ScrollTrigger chief among them — for tying any property to scroll. When an animation has to orchestrate many moving pieces over time, this is the engine for it. It drives the grid on this page.

CATEGORY

engine

TIPS

  • Plugins like ScrollTrigger ship separately: register them once with gsap.registerPlugin(), before the first animation that uses them.
  • Inside a component, wrap your animations in gsap.context() and revert it when unmounting, or the tweens outlive the element they were animating.
